implementation: Optional strict runtimeExecution v1 in the original index: actual conversation/stream identity, complete owner, execution revision, pending dispatch/process/handles, known usage plus unknown-usage fact, and local stop observation. No fake Goal, Bot Full inheritance or private execution journal.

Original index-to-body locks, full source/contentRevision claim CAS and same-owner execution-revision mutation CAS. Active, unknown or uncommitted runs are not overwritten. Unknown/corrupt schema remains unchanged and blocks execution.

Sealed metadata publication receipt binds real before/after source and unchanged history/body/sidecar plus exact full index publication. Common cognition advances only through a continuous actual Store receipt and then still checks the cold source.

Goal cognition returns no ordinary publication receipt and retains original authority, lease, budgets and billing. Actual non-Goal HTTP tests persist response usage but reject continuation over foreign body/model changes. Their Source is explicitly synthetic, not a production ordinary Source assembler.

One aggregate per stream uses the original runtime_turn ledger and real sealed receipt acknowledgment, bound to data root, owner, identity, usage and attribution. No per-physical-request ledger turns.

TS strict decoder reuses pure process-envelope checking; original Goal identity validation remains strict. Its generated coordination worker was rebuilt and the unescaped 46-line pure-helper diff reviewed. TS Store preservation is not TS production execution guard participation.
behavioralEvidence: Nine actual Store tests: two competing processes with the same initial source; real exit87 after publication; source-bound receipt continuity; foreign body/model changes; final ledger dedupe and next admission; copied-root receipt rejection; process lifecycle regression; canonical Grant/Result and actual Evidence registration; unknown retention and independent later conversation.

claim_child is ignored only as a subprocess fixture. Parent tests actually run it. Offline orphan mkdir lock removal is isolated fixture maintenance only, after wait() proves the sole writer exited, with an original diagnostic copy. No production lock expiry or owner-death inference.
Five cognition test functions use actual model HTTP sockets and canonical Store usage publication. No ordinary production Host or full Context Source acceptance is claimed.

49 pinned TS/Rust decoder vectors; oracle executed under Node and Bun. Twelve real TS Store/native interop checks under each Node/Bun host. Native bridge PATH=/nonexistent. TS owner examples are explicitly raw serialization fixtures, not production owner creation.

Full native verify exit0: 620 Rust including247 actual public Host cases; 627 roots/3521 TS/native checks; 9 PTY. Warnings-denied all-target clippy, fmt, root typecheck, root architecture/UI, Protocol build/typecheck/336 TS tests passed.

Fixed featureless release artifact passes eight actual model/file/Shell/Git/Web/MCP Host cases under env-i, isolated HOME, PATH=/nonexistent, then13 roots/76 TS reads. These remain actual Goal/worker Host cases, not ordinary prompt exec.
